colPal = c(
  'navy',
  '#0c6980',  # Deep teal
  '#7eaba6',  # Seafoam
  '#e3bc5d',  # Soft amber
  '#ffd966',  # Pale gold
  '#ff8d8d',  # Coral pink

  '#344e41'   # Olive forest green (earthy and complementary)
)

# shp

dir.create("../../figures", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

```{r 6benthosData, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, error=FALSE, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.height=8, fig.cap='a) Geomorphic layer as sourced from the Allen Coral Atlas for Wistari, Heron, Sykes and One Tree reefs overlayed with all cleaned Eactern Reef Egret tracking locations with summaries for number of fixes with geomorhic types for b) morph type and, c) day or night'}


source("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-JamesCookUniversity/Projects/THESIS_PHD_NLJ_2024/CH5_PREForaging/src/6.BenthosType.R")

# Define color palette
my_cols <- wesanderson::wes_palette("Zissou1", n = length(unique(geodat$geomorphicCover)), type = "continuous")

# First plot: geomorphic classes
island_labels <- data.frame(
  name = c("Heron Island", "One Tree Island"),
  lon  = c(151.914, 152.090),
  lat  = c(-23.443, -23.503)
)

g1 <- geodat %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = geo, aes(fill = class), col = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_cols, name = "Geomorphic feature") +
  geom_sf(data = lightPoints, shape = 21, fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(data = island_labels, aes(x = lon, y = lat, label = name),
             size = 2.5, fontface = "bold", fill = "white", label.size = 0.2,
             nudge_x = c(-0.02, 0.02),
             nudge_y = c(-0.02, 0.02),
             segment.color = "red", segment.size = 0.5,
             min.segment.length = 0) +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.margin  = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")
  )

# Third plot: stacked bar by MORPH
# Combined grouped bar: MORPH × lightPeriod facets
geodat_summary <- geodat %>%
  dplyr::filter(geomorphicCover != "Island", !is.na(geomorphicCover)) %>%
  group_by(geomorphicCover, MORPH, lightPeriod) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

gBar <- ggplot(geodat_summary, aes(x = geomorphicCover, y = count, fill = MORPH)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~lightPeriod) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colPal[c(1, 6)]) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of fixes", fill = "Morph") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )

layout <- "
AAAA
AAAA
AAAA
BBBB
BBBB
"

geoPlot <- g1 / gBar +
  plot_layout(design = layout) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'a')

geoPlot

saveRDS(geodat, "~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-JamesCookUniversity/Projects/THESIS_PHD_NLJ_2024/CH5_PREForaging/data/DFs/benthosFinal.rds")

saveRDS(geoPlot,"~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-JamesCookUniversity/Projects/THESIS_SEABIRDS_2025/figures/CH6_AppFig4_geomorphology.rds")

# Local copy for self-contained project folder (for sharing with reviewers)
# Wrapped in tryCatch so a local sync/permissions issue never halts the render
tryCatch({
  saveRDS(geoPlot,"../../figures/CH6_AppFig4_geomorphology.rds")
  ggsave("../../figures/CH6_AppFig4_geomorphology.png", geoPlot, width = 9, height = 9, dpi = 300)
}, error = function(e) message("Local reviewer-copy save skipped (CH6_AppFig4): ", conditionMessage(e)))

```

```{r 6benthosData2, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, error=FALSE, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.cap="Number of GPS fixes in each geomorphic cover type with 50th (solid black line), 75th (dashed black line) and 95th percentiles (solid red line) with values indicated in the top right hand corner."}

source("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-JamesCookUniversity/Projects/THESIS_PHD_NLJ_2024/CH5_PREForaging/src/6.BenthosType.R")



# 1. Quantiles
quarts <- geodat %>%
  st_drop_geometry()%>%
  dplyr::group_by(geomorphicCover) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Q2 = quantile(nearestTide, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3 = quantile(nearestTide, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q95 = quantile(nearestTide, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    label = paste0(
      "Q50: ", round(Q2, 2), "\n",
      "Q75: ", round(Q3, 2), "\n",
      "Q95: ", round(Q95, 2))
  )

# 2. Max y per facet
max_y <- geodat %>%
    st_drop_geometry()%>%
  dplyr::group_by(geomorphicCover) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(y_max = max(table(cut(nearestTide, breaks = seq(min(nearestTide), max(nearestTide), by = 0.1)))), .groups = "drop")

# 3. Join + max x (for top-right corner)
max_x <- geodat %>%
  dplyr::group_by(geomorphicCover) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(x_max = max(nearestTide, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

quarts_labeled <- quarts %>%
  dplyr::left_join(max_y, by = "geomorphicCover") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(max_x, by = "geomorphicCover")

# 4. Plot
# Step 1: Filter and drop unused levels (in correct order)
geodat_clean <- geodat %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(geomorphicCover)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(geomorphicCover = factor(geomorphicCover))  # Now a factor with only used levels

# Step 2: Also clean the summary data (used in vlines/labels)
quarts_clean <- quarts_labeled %>%
  dplyr::filter(geomorphicCover %in% unique(geodat_clean$geomorphicCover)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(geomorphicCover = factor(geomorphicCover))  # Match factor structure

# Step 3: Plot
benthPlot<-ggplot(geodat_clean, aes(x = nearestTide)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.1, fill = "lightblue", color = "white") +
  geom_vline(data = quarts_clean, aes(xintercept = Q2), linetype = "solid", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(data = quarts_clean, aes(xintercept = Q3), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(data = quarts_clean, aes(xintercept = Q95), linetype = "solid", color = "red") +
  geom_text(data = quarts_clean,
            aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
            hjust = 'right', vjust = 'top', size = 2.4, lineheight = 0.95,
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ geomorphicCover, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  labs(x = "Tide Height (m)", y = "Frequency") +
  theme_minimal()

benthPlot

saveRDS(benthPlot,"~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-JamesCookUniversity/Projects/THESIS_SEABIRDS_2025/figures/CH6_AppFig5_benthosUse.rds")

# Local copy for self-contained project folder (for sharing with reviewers)
# Wrapped in tryCatch so a local sync/permissions issue never halts the render
tryCatch({
  saveRDS(benthPlot,"../../figures/CH6_AppFig5_benthosUse.rds")
  ggsave("../../figures/CH6_AppFig5_benthosUse.png", benthPlot, width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300)
}, error = function(e) message("Local reviewer-copy save skipped (CH6_AppFig5): ", conditionMessage(e)))

```
